verses.text: Ix sb'opaxk'e spalacio winhaj Salomón chi', 13 ab'il ix yak' winh sb'oani.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun niwan pat winh, te lewan ix aj yool. Ix yak'an skuch winh Spatil Te Te' yik Líbano. 45 metro ix aj sk'atul, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj yol schikin, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix ajk'e schaanhil. Chanh tzol ix ajoch yoyal, nab'a k'ute'. Haxo t'a sjolomtak te' oy chi', ix ek' te' patzab' nab'a k'ute'.
Ha juntzanh te' patzab' chi' 45 te', ox tzol ix ajek' te', 15 te' t'a junjun tzol. Haxo t'a yib'anh te' ix b'at te' nab'a k'ute' ix och yib'anhok jun pat chi'.
Ox tzol ix ajk'e swentenail t'a junjun spak'ul. K'elk'umb'a ix aj juntzanh wentena chi'.
Oxox sti' aykan t'a junjun yol schikin. Hanheja' k'elk'umb'a ix aj junjun. Ha smarcoal spuertail yet' swentenail, tojol ix ajek' k'atan t'a yib'anh.
Ix b'opax junxo niwan pat, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj sk'atul, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj yol schikin. Ix yak'an skuch winh Yoyal Pat. Haxo t'a stentail ayoch yoyal yet' yib'anh.
Ix sb'oanpax junxo pat winh b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima. Hanheja' te' k'ute' ix och t'a sattak t'a yool chi'. Ix b'atnhej t'a yich masanto ix k'ek'och t'a yalanh te' patzab'.

Haxo pax b'aj kajan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a spalacio, ha t'a spatik jun pat b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima chi' ay. Lajannhej ix aj sb'o icha ix aj sb'o juntzanh pat chi'. Ix yak'anpax b'ojok junxo pat yik ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto. Lajan ix aj sb'o icha ix aj yik winh.

Ha masanil juntzanh pat chi', icha ix aj skot t'a yich, icha chi' ix aj sk'ek'och t'a schon. Icha chi' ix ajpax yamak'il. Ha k'een k'een ix laj och t'ay te wach' yaj k'een stzeychaji icha yaj yechel. Ha k'een ix cheklajkan t'a spatik yet' t'a yool, polb'il k'een t'a k'een polum k'een.
Hanheja' k'een ix kan t'a yich, a k'een k'een te wach' yaj sb'oi, a k'een ix kan t'ay, te niwak k'een. Ay k'een nanhal yoil metro sk'atul, ay pax k'een oxe' metro yet' 60 centímetro sk'atul.
Ha t'a yib'anh k'een yich chi', ix och k'een k'een tzeyb'il icha wal yaj yechel. Ix ochpax te' k'ute' jochb'il yet' k'een k'een.

Ha t'a spatiktak jun niwan amak' chi', ix och ox tzol k'een k'een. Haxo t'a yib'anh k'een ix ochpax jun tzol te' patzab' nab'a k'ute'. Ichanhej chi' ix aj sk'e t'a chaanh, icha ix aj sb'o jun ix och t'a spatiktak templo yet' pax jun ix b'o t'a yolelul sti' templo chi'.
Ay jun winh aj Tiro skuch Hiram ix yawtejkot winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', yune' winh jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum t'a yinhtilal Neftalí, aj Tiro winh smam winh, te jelan winh sb'oan k'een bronce. Hanhejtona' te jelan pax spensar winh, yojtak winh sb'oan yalnhej tas munlajelal t'a k'een bronce chi'. Yuj chi' ix awtajkot winh yik smunlaj winh t'a winhaj rey Salomón sb'oan juntzanh tas nab'a bronce.
Ix sb'o chab' niwak oy winh, nab'a bronce ix aji, wajxake' metro steel junjun, nanhal swakil metro ix aj b'alan spatik junjun.
Ix sb'oanpax chab' sjolom chab' oy chi' winh. Ha steel juntzanh sjolom chi', chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix aji.
Ha t'a spatiktak chab' sjolom chi' ix ak'jioch k'een cadena bronce, icha k'een malla yaj k'een sb'oi. Uke' ayoch t'a junjun sjolom chi'.
Ix sb'opax cha tzol icha yechel sat te' granado winh. Ix och t'a juntzanh cadena chi' yik tz'och t'a spatik junjun sjolom oy chi'. Lajannhej ix aj schab'il.
Ha juntzanh jolom oy chi', ay am chab'ok metro ayk'ei, lajan yilji icha anh chochol.

Ha chab' sjolom juntzanh oy chi' k'olan k'olan yaji. Haxo t'a yib'anh, hata' ayk'e junxo icha anh chochol chi'. Ha b'aj tz'emul k'een cadena t'a spatiktak jun k'olan k'olan chi', hata' ayoch 200 yechel sat te' granado, cha tzol yajochi.

Ix yak'och chab' oy winhaj Hiram chi' t'a sat templo chi'. Ayik ix yak'anem winh t'a yet'tal, ay jun ix kan t'a ko k'exanh ayik tzonh och t'a yol templo chi', Jaquín ix yak' winh sb'iej. Haxo junxo oy chi' ix kan t'a ko wach', Boaz ix yak' winh sb'iej.
Ha sjolom juntzanh oy chi', lajan yilji icha xumakil anh chochol. Icha chi' ix aj juntzanh oy chi' sb'oan winhaj Hiram chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oan jun niwan pila nab'a bronce winhaj Hiram chi', yik b'aj smolchaj ha ha'. Suyansuyan ix aji, nanhal yoil metro ix aj slewanil sat. Haxo ix ajk'e schaanhil steel, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix aji, haxo ix aj setan smasanil, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo.
Ha t'a yalanh sti' jun pila chi', ayoch chab' tzol yechel sattak te te' icha yilji te' tzima. Lajunhe' ix och t'a junjun 45 centímetro, junnhej ix aj sb'o yet' jun pila chi'.

Ha jun pila chi' b'akhanem t'a yib' snanhal juntzanh yechel nok' mam wakax nab'a bronce. Ha juntzanh yechel nok' chi', oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal sur, oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte, oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, oxe' pax k'elanb'at t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Ha yok juntzanh yechel wakax chi' aykanoch t'a yalanh jun pila chi'.
Ha jun pila chi' nab'a bronce ix aji, chanhek'ab'il spimal. Niwan yajel pechan sti' icha yilji xumakil anh chochol. Ha t'a yol jun pila chi', tz'em 44 mil litro ha ha'.
Ix sb'oanpax lajunhe' carreta winh, nab'a bronce ix aj junjun. Jun metro yet' 80 centímetro ix aj spak'ul schanhil, jun metro yet' 35 centímetro ix ajk'e steel.
Ha juntzanh carreta chi', icha tik yaji: Ay chanhe' smarcoal, makan yoltak sat smarcoal chi'.
Ha t'a sat juntzanh chi' ayoch yechel nok' choj, nok' toro yet' yechel querubín. Ha t'a yib'anh yet' t'a yalanh juntzanh yechel chi', hata' ayoch yelwanub' smarcoal chi'.

Junjun carreta chi' ay chanhe' syantail nab'a bronce, chab' k'een k'een k'atanek' t'a yalanh syaman syantail chi'. Ha t'a schanhil schikintak juntzanh carreta chi' t'a yib'anh, ay syamnub'al nab'a bronce, a syaman jun yune' pila ayem t'a yol jun carreta chi'. Ha juntzanh syamnub' chi' ayoch yelwanub'.

Haxo t'a yol jun carreta chi', ayem jun icha niwan tubo, 45 centímetro schaanhil ayk'eta t'a yib'anh sti' juntzanh carreta chi'. Aypaxoch yelwanub' spatiktak jun niwan tubo chi', haxo schanh pak'anhil jun carreta chi', manh setansetanoklaj.
Ha chanhe' syantail chi' ayoch t'a schikintak schanhil. Haxo pax juntzanh k'een k'een syaman syantail chi', yaman yaj k'een yet' smarcoal chi'. Ha syantail chi', 70 centímetro yaj setan.
Lajan yaj sb'o juntzanh syantail chi' icha yik carruaje yik owal. Ha junjun syantail chi' yaman yaj yet' k'een k'een ayoch b'aj ay yolanil, nab'a bronce, junnhej yaj setan.
Ha chanhe' syamnub'al t'a schikintak carreta chi', junnhej yaj yet' smarcoal junjun carreta.
Ha t'a yib'anh carreta chi', ay junxo setanoch t'a spatik sti', 23 centímetro yajk'e schaanhil. Ha jantak tas ayoch t'a junjun carreta chi', junnhej yaj sb'o smasanil.
Ha t'a spak'ultak yoltak smarcoal chi', ix yak'och yechel querubín winhaj Hiram chi' t'ay, nok' choj yet' te' palma. Ix ochnhej yelwanub' chi' t'a spatiktak smasanil.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'o lajunhe' carreta chi', lajannhej ix aj smasanil, lajannhej yechel, lajannhej pax yilji.

Ix sb'oanpax lajunhe' yet'tal ha' yik juntzanh carreta chi' winh, nab'a bronce ix aji. Lajannhej yechel smasanil. Jun metro yet' 80 centímetro yool junjun, 800 litro am ha' tz'em t'a yool. Junjun ay k'e t'a yib'anh scarretail.

Oye' juntzanh carreta chi' ix kan t'a stojolal ko wach' t'a templo, oye' pax ix kan t'a stojolal ko k'exanh. Haxo jun niwan pila, ha t'a ko k'exanh koch t'a templo chi' ix kani, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'oanpax juntzanh chen, k'een pala yet' niwak uk'ab' winhaj Hiram chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj slajwi sb'o smasanil juntzanh ix schek winhaj rey Salomón b'ojok yikok stemplo Jehová.
Haton masanil juntzanh tik ix chekji sb'o winhaj Hiram: Chab' niwak oy, chab' sjolom oy chi', juntzanh k'een cadena icha k'een malla nab'a bronce ayoch t'a spatiktak jolom oy chi',
yet' pax 400 yechel sat te' granado ayoch t'a juntzanh cadena chi'. Cha tzol yajoch t'a spatiktak chab' jolom oy chi'.
Lajunhe' carreta kuchjinak lajunhe' yet'tal ha',
jun niwan pila, lajchawe' yechel mam wakax kuchjinak,

juntzanh k'een chen, juntzanh k'een pala yet' juntzanh k'een niwak uk'ab'. Masanil juntzanh yamk'ab' tik ix sb'o winhaj Hiram t'a winhaj rey Salomón yikok stemplo Jehová, nab'a bronce to kopopi yilji.
Ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok t'a moldeal t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán t'a lum b'ak'ech lu'um, t'a skal snanhal Sucot yet' Saretán.
Te tzijtum yamk'ab' nab'a bronce, yuj chi' majxo yechtej winhaj rey Salomón chi' jantak yalil k'een bronce chi' ix k'anchaji.
Ix schekanpax winh rey chi' b'ojok masanil juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro t'a yol stemplo Jehová: Jun altar, jun mexa b'aj tz'ak'jiem ixim pan t'a yichanh Jehová,

juntzanh b'akhnub' candil yet' yelwanub' icha yechel xumaak, haton ayoch t'a yichanh lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji. Ay oye' t'a stojolal ko wach', ay oyexo t'a stojolal ko k'exanh, juntzanh candil, juntzanh yamlab',

juntzanh kopa, juntzanh k'een ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj ayoch sk'ak'al candil, juntzanh niwak uk'ab', juntzanh niwak cuchara yet' juntzanh chaynub' yik incienso. Masanil juntzanh chi' nab'a oronhej. Haxo k'een wisagre ayoch t'a spuertail jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, haton t'a yol templo yet' pax yik spuertail templo chi', nab'a oronhej.

Ayik ix b'oel masanil tas ix schek winhaj Salomón b'ojok yik stemplo Jehová, ix schekan winh ik'jokb'at masanil k'een oro, k'een plata yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' yak'nakkan winhaj David smam winh t'a Jehová. Ix schekan winh sik'chajkan t'a yol juntzanh pat ay t'a spatiktak templo b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ochkan yikok Jehová.
